source.citation: W. Suh, M. F. Yanik, O. Solgaard, and S. Fan, Applied Physics Letters 82, 1999-2001 (2003)

reported_features.longitudinal: A narrow transmission resonance reaches unity and moves to higher frequency as the gap decreases.
reported_features.lateral: At h=0.1a, a 0.05a lateral displacement breaks fourfold symmetry and introduces additional resonances near 0.540 and 0.566 c/a.

uncertainty: The paper provides plotted spectra, not machine-readable values. This fixture fixes geometry and qualitative claims only; quantitative reproduction requires digitization with stated uncertainty and plane-wave convergence.
